prerequisite_truststore.problem: JVM fails with PKIX path building failed: sun.security.provider.certpath.SunCertPathBuilderException
prerequisite_truststore.cause: www.cbr.ru sends ONLY the leaf certificate (CN=*.cbr.ru); Windows completes the chain via AIA from the OS store, the JVM does not. JDK cacerts (160 entries) has only the 2015 HARICA roots.
chain: leaf:         CN=*.cbr.ru  (issuer CN=HARICA DV TLS RSA)
intermediate: CN=HARICA DV TLS RSA, O=Hellenic Academic and Research Institutions CA, C=GR (missing in JDK cacerts)
root:         CN=HARICA TLS RSA Root CA 2021, O=Hellenic Academic and Research Institutions CA, C=GR (missing in JDK cacerts)
prerequisite_truststore.fix: scripts/make_cbr_truststore.ps1 — derives the live TLS chain, copies $JAVA_HOME/lib/security/cacerts and imports all non-leaf elements; launch with -Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=<path> -Djavax.net.ssl.trustStorePassword=changeit
